intended_object: For a Grothendieck topology J on a category C and a morphism f : Y ⟶ X, this is the functor that pulls covering sieves on X back along f, sending S to f*S, with J.Cover X viewed as a preorder category. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: On objects it sends a covering sieve S to Sieve.pullback f S, which is still J-covering because Grothendieck topologies are stable under pullback. On morphisms it uses that pulling back is monotone (Sieve.pullback_monotone), so an inclusion of covers S ≤ T gives f*S ≤ f*T. This is exactly the standard pullback of covers, packaged as a functor between the preorder categories of covers. It is stated for an arbitrary category with an arbitrary Grothendieck topology, which is its natural generality.
